proposals.evidence: DEDR 215 compares Tamil arici husked rice, Malayalam ari, Kannada/Kodagu akki and Kota aky husked grain. The selected simple survey rice nouns fit these branches; ari-maṇi and other combined responses require separate components. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4876 explicitly gives Tamil and Malayalam miṉṉal/minnal lightning. The selected neighbouring survey forms preserve the full minnal noun (and Muduga minna with no final lateral recorded); longer finite responses such as minnalarena are excluded rather than shortened. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5373 documents Tamil/Malayalam vāḻai/vāḻa, Kannada bāḻe and Kota vāy vaṇ plantain; DEDR4004 independently documents paḻam/paṇ/paṇṇu fruit, including Irula pammu/pāmu and Kota paṇ. Propose the ordered banana-plant + ripe-fruit components for these surveyed whole words. Their lateral/rhotic/glide, p/h and final-vowel differences are preserved. This is a comparative compound analysis for this survey lect, not a claim that every spelling or lect is printed in DEDR; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. More heavily contracted forms without two identifiable constituents are excluded.
